an5.170:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Ānando Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
an5.170:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Bhaddaji yenāyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi.
an5.170:1.3: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Bhaddajiṃ āyasmā Ānando etad avoca:--
an5.170:1.4: Kin nu kho āvuso Bhaddaji dassanānaṃ aggaṃ, kiṃ savanānaṃ aggaṃ, kiṃ sukhānaṃ aggaṃ, kiṃ saññānaṃ aggaṃ, kiṃ bhavānaṃ aggan ti?
an5.170:2.1: ‘Atth' āvuso Brahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī. Yo taṃ Brahmānaṃ passati, idaṃ dassanānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:2.2: Atth' āvuso ābhassarā nāma deva sukhena abhisannā parisannā,
an5.170:2.5: Yo taṃ saddaṃ suṇāti, idaṃ savanānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:2.7: te santaṃ yeva tusitā sukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, idaṃ sukhānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:2.8: Atth'āvuso ākiñcaññāyatanūpagā devā, idaṃ saññānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:2.9: Atth' āvuso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagā devā, idaṃ bhavānaṃ aggan' ti. 3.
an5.170:2.10: Sameti kho idaṃ āyasmato Bhaddajissa, yad idaṃ bahujanenā ti?
an5.170:3.3: Tena h' āvuso Bhaddaji suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmī ti.
an5.170:3.4: ‘Evam āvuso' ti kho āyasmā Bhaddaji āyasmato Ānandassa paccassosi.
an5.170:4.1: Yathā passato kho āvuso anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, idaṃ dassanānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:4.2: Yathā suṇato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, idaṃ savanānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:4.3: Yathā sukhitassa anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, idaṃ sukhānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:4.4: Yathā saññissa anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, idaṃ saññānaṃ aggaṃ.
an5.170:4.5: Yathā bhūtassa anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, idaṃ bhavānaṃ aggan ti.
